settings.scope: Freeze before numerical evaluation: independent simultaneous log-gas and calcite-fraction source equations, elemental and phase complementarity, source H/S and all positive gas relative errors. No use of the nested scalar phase root in the reference.

model_parameters.scope: Restricted isobaric equilibrium at common USGS source standard pressure. Virtual domain Ctotal>Catotal, Ototal>3Catotal, N2>0; inventories include atoms in all solid and gas phases. Pure phases, ideal gas, no kinetics/volume/real-brick claim.

carbon_source.gas_constant_policy: Historical book R retained for separate same-source nominal calculation.

CO.domain_note: Cp coefficient table prints upper2500K; individual ideal-gas table states2200K. Selected1200K is within both; preserve conflict.

readback.new_network_pdf_access: 403; already available official PDF inspected locally, no new retrieval claimed.

carbon_source.source_choice: Preserve the complete selected USGS nominal source. Do not silently replace CO entropy with another compilation. Published coefficient-fit covariance and relevant real-char properties remain unknown.

nist_co_cross_source_comparison.classification: Independent published compilation value, not an experimental holdout and not substituted into the USGS model.

carbon_source.scope: Pure reference graphite and ideal gases; not measured sludge char, finite reaction rate, volatile inventory, or actual brick atmosphere.

calcite_source.title: Thermodynamic Properties of Minerals and Related Substances at 298.15 K and 1 Bar (10^5 Pascals) Pressure and at Higher Temperatures
calcite_source.entropy_reference_policy: Use the 298.15 K row of each individual high-temperature table (two decimal places). Keep the one-decimal summary values in the old facts unchanged.
calcite_source.rounding_policy: Each nonblank printed decimal or scientific-notation number carries half its last printed unit for arithmetic consistency comparisons only. Omitted Cp terms remain exact zero terms of the printed nominal formula. This is not physical uncertainty.
unknowns: High-temperature physical fit uncertainty and covariance

reference_state.reference: Elements in their standard states at 1 bar and stated temperature for formation columns; h(T) storage coordinate must use hf(298.15)+sensible increment, not hf(T) alone.
reference_state.gas_constant_policy: Historical book constant retained as source metadata, never silently replaces runtime modern R.

cp_equation.derivation_classification: exact analytic integral of supplied nominal polynomial; no fitting or coefficient adjustment

uncertainty.method_summary: The book assigns estimated uncertainties; its convention for calorimetric measurements is twice the standard deviation of the mean. Individual upstream uncertainty derivations and cross-species covariance have not been reconstructed.
uncertainty.printed_zero_uncertainty_note: Printed 0.0 is retained at its displayed precision, not interpreted as physically exact.

species.molar_mass_note: Original printed formula weight in grams per mole; historical 1985 atomic weights; no mass uncertainty supplied.

cp.blank_cells_interpretation: Blank cells are omitted terms in the printed polynomial, represented explicitly as zero only in coefficients_nominal; not missing material values filled with zero.

species.check_point_definition: enthalpy_function_j_mol_k is (H(T)-H(298.15 K))/T, not H(T)-H(298.15 K) and not formation enthalpy at T.

interpretation_guards: Only selected original facts are transcribed; no source pages or full PDF included in tracked artifact.
Formation columns at high T use elements at that T; they are not single-species storage enthalpy curves.
Molar volumes apply at 298.15 K and 1 bar; no temperature-independent high-T law or density error envelope is inferred.
Cp source coefficients and independently printed temperature rows remain distinct and may differ because of printed precision or other source inconsistency; derived checks never rewrite either.
No Shomate fitting, no MIA3 raw-sludge properties, no reaction rate or firing recipe.

carbon_parameters.scope: Restricted equilibrium with pure reference graphite and ideal CO/CO2/O2/N2. No finite char chemistry or ignition dynamics.

calcite_parameters.gas_constant_policy: Use the historical USGS book R for this separate source consistency calculation; do not replace any other module R.

verification.rounding_policy: Printed half-last-unit intervals propagated through the linear Cp integrals, Href and Sref. Formation G and logK table comparison retains its own half-last-unit interval. These are arithmetic envelopes, not physical uncertainty. No post-comparison budget fitting.
